name: calf-raise-dumbbell-seated-one-leg
title: Calf Raise: Dumbbell (Seated, One Leg)
primer: This version of a calf raise allows you to exercise each leg individually.
steps: Place a block on the floor about one foot in front of a bench.
Sit on the bench with a dumbbell across your upper thigh and the ball of one foot on the block.
Slowly raise your heel as high as possible without lifting your foot off the block, then lower it.
tips: This exercise is helpful to people who are rehabilitating from injury as it allows you flexibility with the weight.
